text.content:
Mellow as ever, and armed.

Turf: Rooftop gardens behind Voodoo Boy lines in Pacifica
Known for: Smokable "ganga", and since the war, food
Allies & rivals: Patron: the Voodoo Boys. Barghest burns a garden every few months

They grew their ganga in Pacifica in 2045 and never left. Since the Unification War they grow food too, on rooftop gardens behind Voodoo Boy lines. When Barghest burns a garden, the Hippies replant it.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04
